name: Auto Mesh Framework Validation Probe
description: Manual-test-only public SDK probe for the Auto Mesh algorithm registry, the native funnel guard, custom dispatch, Undo/Redo and the selector row.

permissions.reason: Read the probed ArtMesh geometry and texture pixels during exact-host validation.
Restore the probed ArtMesh geometry after each validation step.
Select the probed algorithm through the session registry during validation.
Wait for the Editor startup notification before the probe judges the session.
Write the validation result properties file and the mesh dump.
